text: I found my apprentice Gregor, but he is trapped in another realm, where I was unable to communicate with him.
zh: 我找到了我的学徒格雷戈，但他被困在另一个位面里，我没法同他交流。
突然出现了一些暗影生物。

text:
Weren't you listening to me earlier?
I connected my mind with the energies of the Stonehenge.
zh:
你刚才没在听我说话吗？
我把我的心智与巨石阵的能量连接了起来。

text: This allowed me to follow the energies to their origin, into a completely different astral realm.
zh: 这让我得以循着能量追溯其源头，进入了一个截然不同的星界位面。

text: However, I had to leave my body, leaving me vulnerable to every threat.
zh: 然而，我不得不脱离肉体，这让我在任何威胁面前都不堪一击。

text: This new realm was unknown to now and left me with a haunting feeling.
zh: 这个新位面此前无人知晓，它让我心头萦绕着一股挥之不去的不安。

text: Well, he seemed exhausted, but alive.
zh: 嗯，他看上去精疲力竭，但还活着。

text: I can't tell how long he is going to make it, though.
zh: 不过，我说不准他还能撑多久。

text:
Shadow creatures, you say?
I remember seeing strange creatures while I was looking for Gregor.
zh:
你说暗影生物？
我记得在寻找格雷戈的时候，也见过一些奇怪的生物。

text: They might have appeared here by taking advantage of my link between this realm and the other.
zh: 它们可能是趁着我在两个位面之间建立联系时，钻了空子来到这里的。

text: As of right now, I have no way of getting Gregor out of there.
zh: 眼下，我没有任何办法把格雷戈从那里救出来。

text: Gregor will have to endure the situation until we find a way to transfer ourselves into the other realm.
zh: 在我们找到进入另一个位面的方法之前，格雷戈只能自己撑住了。

text:
You, for one, have been a great help!
I must express my gratitude.
zh:
而你，帮了大忙！
我必须向你表达谢意。

text: The academy needs people like you!
zh: 学院正需要你这样的人！
